title: Storing a Wool Suit Through the Off-Season
excerpt: A suit you're not wearing for a few months still needs attention — otherwise it won't look right the day you need it again.
author: Lipek Fashion Team
body: Have the suit professionally cleaned before long-term storage, not after. Any oils or residue left in the fabric attract moths and can set permanently over months of storage.
Use a wide, shaped hanger rather than a wire one — wire hangers distort the shoulder line over time, which is exactly the part of a jacket that's hardest to fix.
Store in a breathable garment bag, never sealed plastic. Wool needs airflow, and trapped moisture is the fastest way to end up with mildew.
Keep suits out of direct sunlight and away from damp basements or attics with big temperature swings — stable, dry, dark storage keeps both colour and shape intact.
